mapper.select: select bm_lot_summary_item.id, bm_lot_summary_item.label_name, bm_dataset.id as dataset_id, bm_dataset.name as dataset_name, bm_dataset_point.id as dataset_point_id, bm_dataset_point.name as dataset_point_name from bm_lot_summary_item left join bm_dataset_point on bm_lot_summary_item.dataset_point_id = bm_dataset_point.id and bm_dataset_point.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_dataset on bm_dataset.id = bm_dataset_point.dataset_id and bm_dataset.is_deleted = 0 where bm_lot_summary_item.is_deleted = 0 and bm_lot_summary_item.lot_summary_id = #{lotSummaryId} order by bm_lot_summary_item.id
